sections.content: When the subject is plural, a predicate adjective takes -k too: Ő magas (He is tall) but Ők magasak (They are tall) — the adjective agrees in number, the same way a noun's plural does.
sections.title: Adjective agreement

sections.content: This -k only appears when the adjective stands alone as the predicate (Ők magasak); in front of a noun it never changes — a magas fiúk (the tall boys), not a magasak fiúk.
